scope: Native synthetic SOMA streaming, disjoint cell splits and a one-epoch-equivalent CPU training smoke test.
limits: Small synthetic local experiment; no live Census, biological or agent evaluation.
The CPU smoke test does not establish model convergence or generalization.
Only single-process loading and Linux x86_64 were tested locally.
Cell-level random splits do not prevent donor or dataset leakage.
Hosted workflow results are separate from local controls.
